cms.introPublic: Units you publish here reach every Darsi learner, guests included. Drafts stay private until you publish.
cms.introOrg: Units you publish here are only for your organization's teachers and students. Drafts stay private until you publish.
cms.noneBody: Start a unit, or import one from a JSON file.
cms.importHintPublic: A unit file exported here or written by hand. Its id is kept, so importing ai-1.json lets you edit the built-in unit: once published, your version replaces it.
cms.importHintOrg: A unit file exported here or written by hand. It gets a new id for your organization.
cms.importCheck: Unit {id}: {lessons} lessons, with {errors} errors and {warnings} warnings to look at in the editor.
cms.notAUnit: This JSON isn't a unit (it has no lessons).
cms.idTaken: A unit with the id {id} already exists. Open it from the list instead.
cms.title: Title
cms.tryHint: One thing to do in class tomorrow. Shown when the lesson ends.
cms.noSteps: No steps yet. A lesson usually goes: watch, read, practise, project, reflect.
cms.explainHint: Shown after answering. Explain why, in one or two sentences.
cms.label: Label
cms.orderHint: Write the items in the correct order; learners see them shuffled.
cms.fillHint: Write the sentence and put each answer in square brackets: A sensor turns [heat] into a [number]. Add extra words to make the word bank harder.
cms.acceptHint: One per line. Capital letters and Arabic diacritics don't matter.
cms.spotsHint: Each spot is a box on the message, in percent of its width and height. Learners must find every spot.
cms.bodyHint: Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
cms.sizeHint: Shown before playing. Filled in when you upload.
cms.videoPathHint: For built-in videos: a /media/ path, with {lang} where the language code goes.
cms.transcriptHint: Every video needs a transcript: some teachers read rather than spend data.
cms.slidesHint: Slides for teaching this lesson in class. Speaker notes and narration help when making a video.
cms.layout.title: Title
cms.narrationHint: What a voice-over would say for this slide.
cms.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
cms.tooBig: This file is over {max} MB. Make it smaller (for videos: 240p, one idea, under 4 minutes).
cms.previewBlocked: Fix this lesson's errors to preview it.
cms.conflict: Someone else saved this unit while you were editing. Export your version (Export JSON), reload the page and bring your changes back in.
cms.published: Published as version {n}. Learners get it the next time they open Darsi.
cms.publishBlocked: Not published: the server found errors ({n}). Fix them and try again.
cms.unpublishConfirm: Take this unit away from learners? Their progress is kept, and you can publish it again later.
cms.unpublished: Unpublished. Learners no longer see this unit.
cms.deleteConfirm: Delete {title} for good, with its uploaded files? Learners' progress is kept.
cms.leaveConfirm: Leave without saving? Your changes will be lost.
cms.issue.badId: Not a valid id: {value}. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
cms.issue.answerNotInOptions: The answer must be one of the options.
cms.issue.answersNotInOptions: Correct answers must be options, each chosen once.
cms.issue.fillBlanks: Put at least one blank in the sentence, in square brackets.
cms.issue.fillAnswers: Each language needs one answer per blank ({n}).
cms.issue.fillBank: Answers must all be different, and the word bank must hold each of them once.
cms.issue.badUrl: Not a safe link: use an uploaded file, a /media/ path or an https:// link.
cms.issue.checkpoint: The pause question must be a Choose one or a True or false question.
cms.issue.tooLarge: Too big: keep it under {max} KB (shorten long text or split the unit).
cms.issue.missingAr: Arabic is missing (learners will see the English).
cms.issue.noSlides: No slides yet: the classroom slides will be empty.
cms.tracks.title: Tracks and levels
cms.tracks.intro: Every unit belongs to one track and one level. The tracks here are what learners choose from, and what you and organizations' editors file units under. Phones pick up a change within a minute of saving.
cms.tracks.builtInHint: Built-in tracks keep their colour and icon. You can rename them, hide them or give them more levels.
cms.tracks.idHint: Lowercase English letters, digits and hyphens. It can't change after the first save.
cms.tracks.name: Name
cms.tracks.levelsMin: Units use up to level {n}, so this track can't have fewer levels.
cms.tracks.hideHint: Learners don't see a hidden track or its units. Editors can still prepare units in it.
cms.tracks.inUse: Units use this track. Move them to another track before deleting it.
cms.tracks.saved: Saved. Phones get the new tracks within a minute.
cms.tracks.conflict: Someone else saved the tracks while you were editing. Reload the page to see their changes, then make yours again.
cms.tracks.blocked: Not saved: units still use what you changed.
cms.stepHint.video: A short video with a transcript.
cms.stepHint.read: A short text to read, with key terms.
cms.stepHint.truefalse: Decide if a statement is true.
cms.stepHint.match: Match each item to its pair.
cms.stepHint.order: Put steps in the right order.
cms.stepHint.fill: Fill the gaps from a word bank.
cms.stepHint.hotspot: Find the warning signs in a message.
cms.stepHint.scenario: Choose what to do in a situation.
cms.stepHint.project: A task to do in class, with a rubric.
cms.copyHint: The copy goes at the end of that unit and is saved there as a draft. Learners don't see it until that unit is published.
cms.copyNone: There's no other unit to copy into yet.
cms.copyConflict: That unit changed meanwhile. Try again.
cms.tracks.unknown: Not in the tracks list: pick one of the others
